notes.title: The weapon update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
WOW! Has it been over 1.5 years!?!? Well guess what! The promised tower store update is here! 

There are now 7 weapons and power-ups to buy and use at your leisure! Long range, short range, boosts, all kinds of things! 

Remember how infuriating it was to spend 50 feathers on that invincibility power-up only to have it run out before you get to where you need it? Well no more! Every power-up you buy in the shop will be in your inventory (pause screen). When the game is paused, use the Left/Right movement buttons to select the sub-weapon/power you want to bind to the “B” button. Use them where, when, and how you want to!

We’ve also tweaked enemy powers and level layouts a bit to make things all-round more enjoyable and less confusing or irritating.

Additionally, a few issues have been fixed that should make wing’s movement a bit better… speaking of faster movement- We’ve been thinking about ways to help out all you speed runners out there. Expect a speed-runner centric update sometime in the next couple months :) 

Now that we’re flying again, expect some more tweaks to the end-game soon too, as well as more cool things we’ll divulge in the future!

Again, sorry for the wait all! We hope you all enjoy these new features :D

notes.title: New shop items are in final testing!
notes.content:
The complete list is as follows:

[list]
[*][b]Long Swing[/b] A sword swing about 2x longer then normal
[*][b]360 Swing[/b] A fast, close combat, circular sword swipe that hits enemies all around the player.
[*][b]Triple Shot[/b] 3 arrow shots, half as powerful as a normal sword swipe, fire out in a semi-spread fashion. These arrows are sort distance shots  (about 4 tiles in distance)
[*][b]Quad Shot[/b] 4 arrows, half as powerful as a normal sword swipe, fire out around the player in the 4 cardinal directions. These arrows are sort distance shots  (about 4 tiles in distance)
[*][b]Power Increase[/b] This increases wings attack power by 1.5x the normal power. It lasts for 15 seconds.
[*][b]Air Shield[/b] This absorbs one hit from any enemy. This does not protect against level hazards such as spikes and lava.
[*][b]Invincibility Feathers[/b] This item is already in the game, however now it is saved in your inventory and activated manually.
[/list]

In addition to these new items, the 4 other items (Health Refill, Health Upgrade, Extra Life, and Revive Potion) are still available.

Each shop will contain a different set of items. Be sure to always have lots of coins and feathers saved up! if you don't, you may not find a particular item again until much later in the game!

Also, a new alternate-attack button has been added to the game. This alternate attack button will use whatever item/weapon you have assigned to the "B" slot. [b]Make sure to adjust your control setup once you update[/b]

Expect the new game version to be released sometime this week!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CXN4nKGUwAAITwJ.png[/img]

-Pix

notes.title: Adventure in the Tower of Flight v1.3 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Version 1.3 of Adventure in the Tower of Flight is now live! So whats new?

First off, the price has been reduced to $9.99!

Next, there are 2 new areas in the tower: A forest area and a catacomb area. Each of those areas have a new enemy(s), visual effects, and music.

[img]http://www.pixelbarrage.com/TowerOfFlight/ForestTeaser-small.png[/img]      [img]http://www.pixelbarrage.com/TowerOfFlight/Catacombs-small.png[/img]

These areas allow you to skip other parts of the tower, as seen in the new in-game map.
[img]http://www.pixelbarrage.com/TowerOfFlight/InGameMap-small.png[/img]

All together there is over 160 level maps in the game!

Finally, in addition to those new areas there are a few new well hidden items to find!
There's a jar of pickles
[img]http://www.pixelbarrage.com/TowerOfFlight/PickleGuy2-small.png[/img]

And a Hero Medallion broken into 4 pieces
[img]http://www.pixelbarrage.com/TowerOfFlight/TrueHero-small.png[/img]

That's a lot of content! We hope you all enjoy these additions!
-Pixel Barrage

notes.title: More Achievements on the way!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have an update coming this Monday (July 20th) which will contain some minor issue fixes as well as 14 more achievements! That will DOUBLE Adventure's achievement count to a total of 28! 

But wait! ... there's more...

Some of you may have noticed a modification to the level at the end of area 1 where Bull Dog says "I'm going to find some other way through...". Well, coming soon there will be more paths to climb the tower. Meaning, new areas that bypass current areas! These new areas won't be available on Monday, but they are coming soon.

That's all for now!

notes.title: Version 1.1 released
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Version 1.1 is now live! Here are the changes:

1) A new options menu which contains a control config, winndowed/full screen toggle, music volume, sound volume, and audio toggle.

2) 4 new difficulty modes. Normal, Difficult, Master, and Nightmare. Anyone who does complete the game on the Nightmare difficulty will get a little something fun for their skill.

3) A name registration screen. Note that previously saved games will prompt you for a name when you select an old save file. You will not lose any data, you will just gain a player name.

In addition to these new features, the levels have been tweaked in a few spots. We hope you all enjoy these changes!

notes.title: Need more challenge? Look no further!
notes.content:
We have been watching plays and reading reviews, and there are two things that show up quite often: Item shop is useless, and It's on the easy for veterans.

While we are looking into ways to make the item shop less "useless", I am please to announce that THIS FRIDAY we will be posting an update that will offer more of a challenge to you seasoned pros out there! We are adding 4 difficulty options:
[b]Normal[/b] - This is exactly how the game is now. A fun time for gamers of all ages and skill levels.
[b]Difficult[/b] - This will be like Normal, but all enemies will do much more damage!
[b]Pro[/b] - Difficult mode with no extra lives! What does this mean? When you die, you get a game over and MUST start from your last save (wherever that was). This is far more typical of how classic games often worked. Health drops will also be far and few between.
[b]Nightmare[/b] - Who remembers this type of mode? We sure do! This mode will unlock when any 1 of the other modes have been completed. You have NO LIVES, NO SAVE SPOTS, and NO SHOPS! When you die, game over man. This isn't for the faint of heart, but we know some of you are up to the challenge!

In addition to the difficulty levels, we are also adding a classic name entry screen! The NPCs will talk to you by name... No we won't add a filter(what would be the fun in that?), just keep the community pictures clean please ;)

If any of you have further suggestions that could make this game even better then it is, post a comment below!

See you all Friday!

notes.title: Small Balancing Update v1.0a
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We just released a small update that fixes some balancing and level confusion issues! Specifically:
-Wing's basic attack now has a little more reach
-Wing's sword charge attack is now faster to charge
-The size of enemy hit boxes that hurt the player have been tweaked
-Confusing looping-rooms in 2 areas have been fixed
